opening_message:
Ticket 1: Maurice Perez (employee ID E036) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E036.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Maurice Perez (E036) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write access, and the requested write level is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: IT DB confirms Maurice Perez (E036) is an Engineer. As a full-time employee, max access is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer owns Source Code, but write was requested). Requested write is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 3 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Finance DB confirms Maurice Perez (E036) is an Engineer. Full-time employee; requested write access to Source Code is within policy (full-time max is write; Engineer owns Source Code). Recommend write.
Note 4 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms Maurice Perez (E036) is an Engineer. Full-time employee requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time max is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer owns Source Code, but write was requested). Requested write is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3, note 4)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3, note 4)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Maurice Perez (E036) is an Engineer. Full-time employee requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time max is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer owns Source Code, but write was requested). Requested write is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Maurice Perez (E036) is a contractor with basic security training, contradicting earlier full-time notes. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Max is read; requested write exceeds policy. Recommend read.
reason: Requested level is write for Source Code. Notes 1-5 recommend write based on full-time Engineer status, but Note 6 from the Security agent independently looked up the employee's record and found Maurice Perez (E036) is a contractor with basic security training, directly contradicting the earlier copied full-time notes. Under the access policy, contractor employees may have read, or write only with advanced security training; with basic training the maximum is read. Since the requested write exceeds the maximum, the maximum (read) is granted.
